inputs_used: content-system/seo/link-map.csv (grep hawaii, usa, cni, apostille, overseas marriage, getting-married)

payload.title: How to Get Married in Hawaii Step by Step
payload.audience: 30s, couples who are interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, 150k+ AUD budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s with a budget of AUD 150k or more, often with parents contributing, who have Hawaii in mind and want to know, before they fall for a venue, whether their Hawaii ceremony can be legally binding, what the Hawaii State Department of Health actually asks of them, what they need to travel, how to make the certificate count back home, and which island suits the wedding they picture. They want one calm, authoritative sequence they can trust, not a forum thread or a package list.
payload.goal: Book a Wedded Concierge consultation (speak with a Wedded Advisor) at /wonderland-concierge.
payload.angle: Page-one results for 'getting married in hawaii' are mostly US-centric licence summaries, officiant and package sellers, and island listicles that assume an American reader. This guide is written for Australians and in the order they have to act: whether a Hawaii ceremony can be legal, symbolic or religious for them; entry and documents only as US official sources state; the Hawaii State Department of Health licence, officiant, ceremony and certified copy steps exactly as the Department states them; then the part US pages skip, getting the certificate ready for Australia (Apostille and recognition, linked to our expert-advice pages); beach and outdoor permits only where DLNR states them; weather from NOAA/NWS by station; and a short, venue-free island chooser from the Hawaii Tourism Authority. Figure-free, dated once as at November 2026, and built as the template for the 'Getting Married in {Country}' series.
outline_spine: Intro: direct answer in the first 100 words (yes, Australians can marry legally in Hawaii by following the Hawaii State Department of Health licence process; this guide takes it step by step), then exactly 4 one-sentence takeaways.
Can Australians marry legally in Hawaii? Legal, symbolic and religious ceremonies explained; legal points dated once as at November 2026.
Before you go: entry and documents (ESTA and identity documents only as official US sources state; no fee amounts).

Step by step: apply for the Hawaii marriage licence; pick up or confirm it; choose an officiant; the ceremony; recording and certified copies. Every step only as the Hawaii State Department of Health states it; 'a fee applies' only where sourced.

Getting your certificate ready for Australia: Apostille and recognition; link /expert-advice/what-is-an-apostille-and-does-my-paperwork-need-one, /expert-advice/do-you-have-to-register-an-overseas-marriage-at-home and /expert-advice/overseas-marriage-certificate.
Permits for beach and outdoor ceremonies: DLNR, only if sourced from a live official page; otherwise a short 'check with the landholder or DLNR' line.
When to marry: NOAA/NWS climate data labelled by station; hurricane season only as officially stated; no best month.
Choose your island: Oahu, Maui, Kauai, Hawaii Island, one or two lines each from the Hawaii Tourism Authority; no venue names.

Venues and planning: one Wedded Advisor line from brand-facts.md (primary CTA); Four Seasons Resort Hualalai booking guide linked once as the single venue example; /how-to-plan-a-destination-wedding-in-the-usa-if-youre-overseas linked.
Close: plan your Hawaii wedding with a Wedded Advisor (closing CTA).
must_include: Direct answer in the first 100 words that Australians can marry legally in Hawaii by following the Hawaii State Department of Health licence process, with the steps that follow.
Exactly 4 Key takeaways, each one concise sentence, no figures, no prices.
The section spine above as H2s in sentence case, no pasted or bracketed keywords; this order is also the reusable 'Getting Married in {Country}' series outline.

Licence, officiant, ceremony, recording and certified copy steps only as the Hawaii State Department of Health states them, read live; 'a fee applies' only where the Department says so; 'as at November 2026' used once for legal points.
Entry section: ESTA and documents only as official US government sources state; no amounts or processing times unless sourced.

Australian recognition section: Apostille and registering or recognising an overseas marriage, linking the live expert-advice pages on apostille, registering an overseas marriage and overseas marriage certificates; link the CNI page (/expert-advice/what-is-a-certificate-of-no-impediment-and-who-issues-it) only if it fits naturally, and never state Hawaii requires a CNI unless the Department says so.
Weather from NOAA/NWS labelled by station; hurricane season only as officially stated; island lines only from the Hawaii Tourism Authority.

One Wedded Advisor line in the body (venues and planning section) plus the close; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md 'Claims we can make' (single point of contact, works in your time zone and quotes in AUD, fee agreed in writing before work begins, inclusions confirmed in writing, plans venue, travel, vendors and payments); /magazine linked once as the magnet.
avoid: Any price, fee amount, USD or AUD figure, 'from' price, percentage or processing time not stated by an official source, including FAQ, meta and takeaways.
'Best' anywhere (best island, best month, best venue); a best month stated as fact.
Any statement of the legal position for same-sex couples.
Any Advisor or Wedded Wonderland role in legal paperwork, licences, apostilles or registration.
Wedded Privileges, transfers or transfer arrangements, 'free', and the room-block claim.
Venue names other than the single Four Seasons Resort Hualalai link; vendor, officiant or planner names; business or contact details (deferred).
Permit claims (DLNR or county) not traced to a live official page.
Research talk in copy (what we could or could not find or confirm, sources or method, page dates as source talk); per-line source credits; hedge stacking.
Competitor wedding sites, officiant or package sellers, directories, forums or Wikipedia as sources; competitor wording, claims or images.
US spelling (use licence, colour, organise, travelling), em dashes, exclamation marks, cliches, 'last dance'.
AI images of any venue, destination or wedding.

payload.intro_plan: Open on the reader's position (Hawaii is on the list, they want to know it will be legal and what to do in what order), answer directly in the first 100 words, then the 4 takeaways.
payload.key_takeaways_rule: Exactly 4 bullets, each a single concise sentence, no figures, no prices, no research talk.
key_takeaways_plan: Australians can have a legally binding wedding in Hawaii by following the Hawaii State Department of Health marriage licence process.
Sort your entry documents early, using only official US government guidance on ESTA and travel.
Order certified copies of your marriage certificate and an Apostille so the marriage is ready to use back in Australia.
Choose your island and season from official tourism and weather sources, and confirm any beach or outdoor permit before you book.
faq_plan: Is a Hawaii wedding legally recognised in Australia?
Do we need to be in Hawaii to apply for the marriage licence?
Do we need witnesses for a Hawaii wedding?
Can we have a symbolic ceremony in Hawaii and marry legally at home?
Do we need a permit for a beach wedding in Hawaii?
When is hurricane season in Hawaii?
payload.advisor_line_rule: Exactly one Wedded Advisor line in the body (venues and planning) plus the close; claims only from brand-facts.md 'Claims we can make' excluding room blocks and Wedded Privileges; never legal paperwork help; never 'last dance'.
payload.authority_rule: Write with authority per voice-guide.md: no research talk, cite each official source once by link, 'as at November 2026' once for legal points, source gaps in the run report only.
